data_sources.name: PlantVillage Dataset
data_sources.coverage: 15 classes across 3 crops (Pepper, Potato, Tomato), 20639 images — subset of full 38-class/14-crop dataset
data_sources.note: Full PlantVillage dataset covers 14 crops; only Pepper/Potato/Tomato present so far. Remaining crops needed for Phase 2 (12-crop target).

data_sources.name: Land-grant Cooperative Extension fact sheets
data_sources.coverage: 12/12 disease categories, 8 institutions (Cornell, UMD, UF/IFAS, Penn State, UMaine, UDel, OSU, UC IPM)
data_sources.note: No official USDA plant-disease REST API exists (third-party 'USDA Plants Database API' is defunct; APHIS IPHIS is restricted to state/federal cooperators). These extension sites are the real sources USDA guidance mirrors. See deployment/rag/retrievers/usda.py and build_extension_cache.py.

data_sources.name: PubMed (NCBI E-utilities)
data_sources.coverage: Research papers on plant pathology, queried live per RAG request
data_sources.note: Public API, no key required. See deployment/rag/retrievers/scholar.py.
